c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(d)(ii))

s: Notify the parties and resolve the partition under subdivision eight when co-tenants do not elect to buy all interests.
q: the court shall send notice to all the parties of such fact and resolve the partition action under paragraphs (a) and (b) of subdivision eight of this section.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(d)(iii))

s: Set the date by which electing co-tenants must pay their apportioned price into court.
q: the court shall set a date, not sooner than sixty days after the date the notice was sent, by which electing co-tenants must pay their apportioned price into the court.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(e))

s: Reallocate co-tenant interests and disburse the amounts held when all electing co-tenants pay on time.
q: the court shall issue an order reallocating all the inter-ests of the co-tenants and disburse the amounts held by the court to the persons entitled to them.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(e)(i))

s: Resolve the partition under subdivision eight when no electing co-tenant pays on time.
q: If no electing co-tenant timely pays his or her apportioned price, the court shall resolve the partition action under paragraphs (a) and (b) of subdivision eight of this section
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(e)(ii))

s: Notify paying co-tenants of the unpurchased interests remaining and their price when some electing co-tenants fail to pay.
q: the court, on motion, shall give notice to the electing co-tenants that paid their apportioned price of percentage of the unpurchased interests remaining and the price for all such interests.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(e)(iii))

s: Reallocate the remaining interest to the single co-tenant who pays the entire price.
q: If only one co-tenant pays the entire price for the remaining interest, the court shall issue an order reallocating the remaining interest to such co-tenant.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(f)(i))

s: Resolve the partition under subdivision eight when no co-tenant pays for the remaining interest.
q: If no co-tenant pays the entire price for the remaining interest, the court shall resolve the partition action under paragraphs (a) and (b) of subdivision eight of this section
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(f)(ii))

s: Reapportion remaining interests among co-tenants who each pay the entire price, and refund any excess payment.
q: the court shall reapportion those remaining interests among those paying co-tenants, based on each paying co-tenant's original fractional ownership of the entire parcel
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(7(f)(iii))

s: Order partition in kind unless it would cause great manifest prejudice to the co-tenants as a group.
q: the court shall order partition in kind unless the court, after consideration of the factors listed in subdivision nine of this section, finds that partition in kind will result in great manifest prejudice to the co-tenants as a group.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(a))

s: Approve a request by two or more parties to aggregate their interests when considering partition in kind.
q: the court shall approve a request by two or more parties to have their individual interests aggregated.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(a))

s: Order partition by sale when partition in kind is not ordered, or dismiss the action if no co-tenant requested a sale.
q: the court shall order partition by sale pursuant to subdivision ten of this section provided that, if no co-tenant timely requested partition by sale, the court shall dismiss the action.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(b))

s: Allocate to unknown, missing or defaulted co-tenants a part of the property representing their combined interests, to remain undivided.
q: the court shall allocate to the co-tenants that are unknown, cannot be located, or the subject of a default judgment, if the co-tenants interests were not bought out pursuant to subdivision seven of this section, a part of the property
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(8(d))

s: Consider the statutory factors in deciding whether partition in kind would cause great manifest prejudice.
q: In determining under subdivision eight of this section whether partition in kind would result in great manifest prejudice to the co-tenants as a group, the court shall consider the following:
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(9(a))

s: Conduct a court-ordered sale of heirs property as an open-market sale unless sealed bids or an auction is more advantageous.
q: such sale shall be an open-market sale under this subdivision unless the court finds that a sale by sealed bids or an auction would be more economically advantageous and in the best interest of the co-tenants as a group.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(10(a))

s: Appoint a disinterested licensed broker and set a reasonable commission for an open-market sale.
q: If the parties do not agree on a broker, the court shall appoint a disinterested real estate broker licensed in this state to offer the property for sale and shall establish a reasonable commission.
c: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law § 993(10(b))
